385 class Control
386 {
387 public:
388 Edu totalDur{};
389 Evpu totalWidth{};
390 Evpu minWidth{};
391 Evpu allotWidth{};
392
393 static const xml::XmlElementArray<Control>& xmlMappingArray();
394 };
395
396 // Populated only when the XML node includes a <control> element
397 std::shared_ptr<Control> control;
398
399 // Populated for standard beat entries (inci > 0)
400 Edu dur{};
401 Evpu pos{};
402 Evpu endPos{};
403 Evpu minPos{};
404
405 void integrityCheck(const std::shared_ptr<EnigmaBase>& ptrToThis) override
406 {
407 OthersBase::integrityCheck(ptrToThis);
408 if (control && getInci() != 0) {
409 MUSX_INTEGRITY_ERROR("Beat chart for measure " + std::to_string(getCmper()) + " has a control instance in inci " + std::to_string(*getInci()));
410 }
411 if (getInci() == 0 && !control) {
412 control = std::make_shared<Control>();
413 MUSX_INTEGRITY_ERROR("Beat chart for measure " + std::to_string(getCmper()) + " is missing its control instance.");
414 }
415 }
416
417 constexpr static std::string_view XmlNodeName = "beatChart";
418 static const xml::XmlElementArray<BeatChartElement>& xmlMappingArray();
419};

565class FontDefinition : public OthersBase
566{
567public:
568 static constexpr uint32_t SYMBOL_CHARSET_MAC = 0xfff;
569 static constexpr uint32_t SYMBOL_CHARSET_WIN = 2;
571 explicit FontDefinition(const DocumentWeakPtr& document, Cmper partId, ShareMode shareMode, Cmper cmper)
572 : OthersBase(document, partId, shareMode, cmper) {}
573
576 enum class CharacterSetBank
577 {
578 MacOS,
579 Windows
580 };
581
582 // Public properties corresponding to the XML structure
583 CharacterSetBank charsetBank{};
584 int charsetVal{};
589 int pitch{};
590 int family{};
591 std::string name;
592
606 bool calcIsSymbolFont() const
607 {
608 if (charsetBank == CharacterSetBank::MacOS && charsetVal == SYMBOL_CHARSET_MAC) {
609 return true;
610 }
611 if (charsetBank == CharacterSetBank::Windows && charsetVal == SYMBOL_CHARSET_WIN) {
612 return true;
613 }
614 return false;
615 }
616
617 constexpr static std::string_view XmlNodeName = "fontName";
618 static const xml::XmlElementArray<FontDefinition>& xmlMappingArray();
619};

634class Frame : public OthersBase

636public:
638 explicit Frame(const DocumentWeakPtr& document, Cmper partId, ShareMode shareMode, Cmper cmper, Inci inci = 0)

641 EntryNumber startEntry{};

648 bool iterateRawEntries(std::function<bool(const MusxInstance<Entry>& entry)> iterator) const;

656 void integrityCheck(const std::shared_ptr<EnigmaBase>& ptrToThis) override
657 {
658 this->OthersBase::integrityCheck(ptrToThis);
659 if (startTime && (startEntry || endEntry)) {
660 MUSX_INTEGRITY_ERROR("Frame " + std::to_string(getCmper()) + " has non-zero startTime and non-zero startEntry or endEntry.");
661 }
662 if (!startTime && !startEntry) {
663 MUSX_INTEGRITY_ERROR("Frame " + std::to_string(getCmper()) + " has no start entry.");
664 }
665 if (!startTime && !endEntry) {
666 MUSX_INTEGRITY_ERROR("Frame " + std::to_string(getCmper()) + " has no end entry.");
667 }
668 }
669
670 constexpr static std::string_view XmlNodeName = "frameSpec";
671 static const xml::XmlElementArray<Frame>& xmlMappingArray();
672};

816 util::Logger::log(util::Logger::LogLevel::Info, "Fret instrument " + std::to_string(getCmper()) + " specifies " + std::to_string(numFrets)
817 + " frets but has " + std::to_string(fretSteps.size()) + " diatonic fret steps specified.");
818 }
819 }
